text: But Ins.C. § 533 is read into every insurance contract and bars coverage for harm caused by the “wilful acts” injury of another (see ¶ 3:105 ff.). (4) [3:380] “Employment-related practices” exclusion: As noted, the ISO CGL form may contain an “employment- related practices” exclusion endorsement (CG 21 47 04 98), which excludes personal injury coverage for claims arising out of the refusal to hire, termination of employment, and a variety of other “employment-related practices, policies, acts or omissions …” (see ¶ 3:318). [See Golden Eagle Ins. Corp. v. Rocky Cola Café, Inc. (2001) 94 CA4th 120, 126, 114 CR2d 16, 21, fn. 6 (emphasis added); Low v. Golden Eagle Ins. Co. (2002) 104 CA4th 306, 309-316, 128 CR2d 423, 425-430 (discussing employment-related practices exclusion)] Similar provisions may be found in non-ISO policies. [See Loyola Marymount Univ. v.
